DeviceChain - dcctl bootstrap - kind-devicechain - v1.11.0

Cluster installed

The shared cluster prerequisites are installed. No instance
has been created yet.
  Cluster   kind cluster devicechain (Standard footprint,
            Single)
Next: create an instance on this cluster. It is a separate
step, with its own choices, its own review and its own
approval; nothing of it runs until you approve it.
If you exit here, the cluster stays installed. To create an
instance later, run:
  dcctl bootstrap local <instance> --cluster=devicechain
  [ Exit (the cluster stays installed) ]
> [ Continue to the instance ]
This screen takes keys once it has settled.
